newsitem.title: USA: Paradigm sees larger Q3 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Paradigm sees larger Q3 oper loss.

text.p: Paradigm Technology Inc Tuesday said it will report a greater than expected operating loss for the third quarter due to lower than expected revenue.
The company attributed the expected shortfall in revenue to industry wide pricing pressures and lower than anticipated demand in the fast static random access memory marketplace.

"Although revenue is up approximately 25 percent over the previous quarter, the results for this quarter are disappointing," said Mike Gulett, president and chief executive officer. "In order to improve our market position and operating results, we plan to introduce several new products over the next few months."

"The company expects that it will need to pursue additional sources of liquidity other than cash flow from operations," he added. "We are examining a number of alternate strategies designed to improve Paradigm's financial condition, including the sale of assets, private or public financings, bank financings, and/or other sources of liquidity. Although no assurances can be given, the company is actively pursuing various sources of liquidity."
According to First Call, the company was expected to report a loss of $0.24 a share in the third quarter versus a profit of $0.21 a share on revenues of $14 million in the year ago period.
